name: Regimen DD-4A: Vincristine + Dactinomycin + DOXOrubicin (Stage III-IV / High-Risk Wilms Tumor)

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Pediatric Wilms Tumor v1.2026
source.textbook: Principles and Practice of Pediatric Oncology, 8th ed.

histology: nephroblastoma / Wilms tumor (favorable histology with Stage III/IV or 1p/16q LOH)
supportiveCare: Bowel management to prevent vincristine constipation
Hepatopathy monitoring for sinusoidal obstruction syndrome with dactinomycin
Flank or whole-lung radiotherapy coordination per COG AREN0532/AREN0533
monitoring: CBC with differential prior to each cycle
Echocardiogram baseline and cumulative doxorubicin tracking

drugs.name: vinCRIStine
drugs.notes: vinCRIStine 1.5 mg/m2 (hard cap 2.0 mg) IV push on Day 1. Fatal if given intrathecally.

drugs.name: Dactinomycin
drugs.notes: Dactinomycin 0.045 mg/kg (or 1.35 mg/m2) IV push on Day 1. Reduce dose by 50% during concurrent radiotherapy.

drugs.name: DOXOrubicin
drugs.notes: DOXOrubicin 45 mg/m2 IV infusion on Day 1. Lifetime cumulative anthracycline cardiotoxicity guard applied.
